results.title: Pastel color does not modulate viewers' emotions ...
results.content: In this work, we aimed to approach differences in the emotions perceived by viewers when watching audiovisual projects produced with pastel colors compared with those produced with saturated colors. This research brings more knowledge to how pastel color in images, particularly those of an audiovisual nature, can be used to evoke emotions in the audience.
